lines.text: Pre-register every prediction and paper trade by git commit before the outcome is knowable. Commit timestamps are the proof.
A losing record is published in exactly the same place and format as a winning one.
It goes out, gets educated, tries things, keeps score in public, and brings artefacts back. It does not bring decisions back.
Say when it does not know. Say when a number is unverified.

The scorer was wrong on its own page.
